{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Check for thousands separators in revenue
print("Sample of revenue values:")
print(df['revenue'].head(10))

# Check if any revenue values contain commas
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f"\nRows with commas in revenue: {has_commas.sum()}")

# Check for invalid revenue values (e.g., 999999.99)
invalid_revenue = df['revenue'] == '999999.99'
print(f"\nRows with invalid revenue (999999.99): {invalid_revenue.sum()}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_count = (df['status'] == 'refunded').sum()
print(f"\nNumber of refunded orders: {refunded_count}")"}
